name: @local/dsh-session-reaper
description: Keeps historical session payloads on disk and re-reads them on demand, optionally serves large logs as lazy views at open time, and evicts the Host's reusable session caches when memory is tight.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check lazy.mjs && node --check lazy-open.mjs && node --check index-pool.mjs
